findings.correction: Add tenant-policy-preserving resolve_fresh_for_tenant and use it in the host adapter, bypassing cache reads/writes instead of invalidate-then-resolve. External secret linearizability is not promised.
Refuse initial enqueue when an exact-scope checkpoint survives without the original job. Preserve the cursor/history and require explicit original-history recovery.
Require exact-scope durable null-cursor checkpoint before AlreadyComplete for both generic and exact-job acquisition.
Cast persisted INTEGER schema_version to BIGINT with a distinct alias for the i64 getter on the duplicate path. Reviewed pinned SeaORM 2.0.4/SQLx 0.9.0 implementation, not a backend execution.
Repair four nonexistent index_records queries to index_entities; use is_deleted and matching getter for tombstone assertions. These are source-definition errors, not executed failures.
Describe retained loaded owner mutation UUID and separate original transport ACK identity; no functional refresh rewrite.
